feedback: Great structure and high-stakes twist! A few minor tweaks to make it perfect: 1) Image I3 is used in Cut 2 and Cut 4 back-to-back with weak framing variation—introduce a sweet detail close-up (like Priyam's childhood photo or Kaka's gamucha) before Cut 4 to build early emotional warmth for Priyam. 2) In Cut 9, line 'Kaka ikkees saal se...' is a bit long for a single breath; split or trim slightly so the storyteller delivery hits harder. 3) Add 1-2 silent horror cuts (e.g., extreme close-up of trembling hands or dark shadow crossing) right before the final door knock to maximize the tension dro
lines: Raat ke do baje, band darwaze par dastak hui...
Par ye silsila shuru hua tha teen ghante pehle.
Mikir Hills ke bungalow mein Priyam ko uske Kaka ne bete se badhkar pala tha.
Par har Amavasya ko, Kaka storeroom mein khud ko lock kar lete.
Priyam ne zidd mein aakar aaj woh taala tod diya.
Andar Bhaskar Kaka pitch-black room mein baithe the.
Kaka ikkees saal se Jakh ko apni aatma de rahe the... Priyam ki jaan bachane.
Tabhi main door par zordar dastak hui!
Woh Jakh tha... Kaka ki laash lautane aaya tha.
Kyunki raat ke do baje... Priyam ikkees saal ka ho chuka tha.
